records.label: Show a request's result with a shortcode, template tag or block (field selection, formatting, fallback text)
records.notes: WPGetAPI displays results with [wpgetapi_endpoint] and wpgetapi_endpoint(). The Listings and Builder Widgets surfaces render it; this row is the connection-side contract (allowed requests, caching, escaping). Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org package wpgetapi (frontend/functions.php, includes/block-editor); https://wordpress.org/plugins/wpgetapi/

records.label: Result format (JSON, PHP array, HTML formatted, XML) and nested data path selection
records.notes: WPGetAPI "results_format" option and PRO "Retrieve nested data" / "XML format". XML is parsed with external entities disabled. Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org package wpgetapi (includes/class-wpgetapi-admin-options.php results_format); https://wordpress.org/plugins/wpgetapi/

records.label: Response cache per request profile (TTL, key dimensions, manual purge)
records.notes: WPGetAPI "cache_time" and PRO "Cache API calls". Permission-dependent responses are never shared between users. Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org package wpgetapi (cache_time); https://wordpress.org/plugins/wpgetapi/

records.label: Chain requests: feed values from one response into the next request
records.notes: WPGetAPI PRO "Chain API calls" and "Tokens". Bounded chain depth and the same SSRF policy for every hop. Evidence: https://wordpress.org/plugins/wpgetapi/

records.label: Send a request when a site event happens (user registers, form submitted, order placed, post published)
records.notes: WPGetAPI PRO "Actions - automate your API when an action happens on your site". Event selection and mapping are owned by Forms & Workflows; this row is the request side. Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org package wpgetapi (actions option); https://wordpress.org/plugins/wpgetapi/

records.label: Import API items as posts, products or CCT items with field mapping and scheduled sync
records.notes: WPGetAPI "API to Posts": map API data to custom fields, ACF, taxonomies, images and WooCommerce fields; sync every few minutes up to weekly. Owned with Import / Export and Site Sync; scheduling through Cron. Evidence: https://wordpress.org/plugins/wpgetapi/

coverage.notes: Gap closure from a 2026-11-20 source and readme audit of Advanced WP REST API 1.4, WPGetAPI 2.25.5 and WordPress REST API Authentication 5.0.1.
